prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 94535c38ab5f5fc0
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
mem_la_addr low bits are 2'b10 instead of 2'b00, so every lookahead fetch/data address is misaligned and the bench reports fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero with FAIL 0xdead. Expected word-aligned {..,2'b00} for both the next_pc fetch path and reg_op1 data path. Root cause is line 382 which hard-codes 2'b10 in both branches of mem_la_addr.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 94535c38ab5f5fc0 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
